title: Routines
description: Warm-ups, mobility, stretching and bodyweight routines people can start on their own, without a workout. Each step names an exercise from exercises.json. The order in the file is the order the app lists them in, within each kind.

id.description: Stable short id. Saved sessions and links from other apps (fitness-coach/#routine=<id>) refer to it, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

name.description: Name shown in the app, in sentence case.

kind.description: warmup (before training or a sport), mobility (range of motion, any time), stretch (cool-down), calisthenics (bodyweight strength).

sports.description: Sport ids from sports.json this routine is made for. People who picked one of these sports see it first.

about.description: One or two sentences: what it's for and when to do it.

rounds.description: Times through the whole list, as a circuit. Leave out for once through.

rest.description: Seconds of rest between rounds. Only used with rounds.

exercise.description: Exercise id from exercises.json. Steps whose equipment the person doesn't have are skipped.

seconds.description: How long to hold or keep moving. For an exercise with eachSide, this is per side.

reps.description: How many reps. For an exercise with eachSide, this is per side.
